content: The use of continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) early in the treatment process for adults with type 1 diabetes has been shown to significantly improve glycemic control. This approach also enhances the overall quality of life by reducing the risk of hypoglycemia. Additionally, adults with type 1 diabetes may benefit from automated insulin delivery (AID) systems. These systems dynamically adjust insulin delivery based on real-time glucose levels, thereby optimizing glycemic outcomes and providing more precise management of blood sugar levels.
